about: Covenant warriors the gauntlet sends at you. Each row is one opponent type: a Half Sword fighter (Willie_BP) wearing a real Halo 3 model read from the player's own MCC install by HaloBridge.

columns.halo_map: MCC Halo 3 cache file (relative to the MCC folder) that holds this model
columns.halo_model_candidates: render_model tag names to try, first match wins (HaloBridge logs every elite/brute render_model it sees)
columns.region_permutation: permutation to take per region; 'base' then first available
columns.skeleton: bone_map.skeleton key used to pin model pieces onto Half Sword bones
columns.tint_rgb: flat colour for the model (textures are not converted in v0.1)
columns.health_mult: multiplier on the fighter's Health after spawn
columns.hide_host_body: hide the Half Sword body mesh under the Halo model (physics keeps running)
columns.strip_armor: remove Half Sword armour pieces so they don't poke through
